# GCC runtime notices

License texts from the GCC mirror's COPYING3 and COPYING.RUNTIME, downloaded 2026-09-19:

- https://github.com/gcc-mirror/gcc/blob/master/COPYING3
- https://github.com/gcc-mirror/gcc/blob/master/COPYING.RUNTIME

The portable Windows package statically links compiler runtime libraries from the local w64devkit toolchain. MinGW-w64 runtime notices are supplied separately from that toolchain. No compiler executable is distributed.
